name: Stripe payments
shortDescription: The payment element of the node. It takes card payments through the owner's own Stripe account for the other elements of the node, so they need no payment code and no Stripe keys of their own. It is turned off by default and works once the owner enters the Stripe keys.
longDescription:
Stripe payments is a native element of the node and the one place that holds the owner's Stripe keys. An element that sells something asks it for a payment link (Stripe Checkout: the payment page on Stripe's side, so no card number reaches the node), later asks for the payment status, and can list the payments recorded for it. Stripe tells this element about finished payments and refunds through a signed webhook.

The owner enters the keys on the node screen Settings → Payments → Web2. Without them the element answers that the keys are missing. It is turned off by default; turn it on when the keys are set.
accepts: From the elements of this node, with the node key: a payment request (element, order reference, amount and currency or a Stripe price, return addresses), a Checkout session id, an element id. From Stripe: signed events at /api/stripe-webhook.
returns: A Checkout payment link { id, url }; the status of a payment (paid, open or expired, amount, element, reference); the list of payments recorded for an element. Never a buyer's card, name or e-mail.

reason.en: Turn it on after you enter your Stripe keys
